column1: # Known faults of STEGO's own tree against its code standard (ST-STD-CODE), at the commit that holds this file.
# The tooling record ST-ASR-TOOL03 names this file. The Product owner decided (ST-ASR-Q02, 2026-10-31) that the
# list stays until it is empty. TestOwnTree in code_standard_test.go reads it and the tree from git objects.
#   - the tree at this commit has no fault of the rule outside this list;
#   - this list holds no fault of the rule that the tree no longer has;
#   - this list holds no fault, by rule and key, that the list at the base commit does not hold (the ratchet). The
#     base is the commit ASSURE_RATCHET_BASE names, or else the first parent. A fault may change its reason while
# Where the base is the first parent, the ratchet holds for the commit under test only: the last commit of a push,
# or a whole pull request through its merge ref. In a shallow clone without the parent and with no base given,
# the rule tests are skipped. When you fix a fault, remove its line in the same commit. Do not add a fault: fix it.
# One fault per line, sorted, each fault once: the rule, the key, the file or package, and the reason, with a tab
